words.example: The quarterly review will ask why overtime rose in February.
words.exampleZh: 季度回顾会问二月加班为什么上升。

words.example: Block a morning in November for the annual review of policies.
words.exampleZh: 请在十一月留一个上午做制度的年度回顾。

words.example: Your performance review will cover the probation goals we set.
words.exampleZh: 绩效面谈会对照我们定过的试用期目标。

words.example: The project plan puts staff training ahead of the first clinic day.
words.exampleZh: 项目计划把员工培训排在门诊第一天之前。

words.example: The work plan for June includes the inventory and the fire drill.
words.exampleZh: 六月的工作计划包括盘点和消防演练。

words.example: Account lockout hit the shared lab login after three bad passwords.
words.exampleZh: 三次密码错误之后，检验共用登录触发了账号锁定。

words.example: Disk space on the report server will drop below ten percent by Friday.
words.exampleZh: 到周五，报表服务器的磁盘空间会降到百分之十以下。

words.example: CPU usage on the order server stays near ninety all morning.
words.exampleZh: 医嘱服务器的处理器占用一上午都接近百分之九十。

words.example: The memory leak in the report service grows about a gigabyte each day.
words.exampleZh: 报表服务的内存泄漏每天大约涨一个吉字节。

words.example: The network share for discharge forms disappeared after the file server reboot.
words.exampleZh: 文件服务器重启之后，出院表单的网络共享不见了。
